In detail

South Wales Police recorded 241 crimes inside this ward's official boundary over the 3 months to July 2026 — 6.9 per 1,000 residents, the 20th highest rate of Cardiff's 28 wards. The daytime score here is driven by shoplifting (10), vehicle crime (4), burglary (2); the evening/night score by violent crime (24), anti social behaviour (12), public order (12). Rated against the average of the city's own wards, never against another city.
